correctness.rationale: Forced-adjacency contraction gives exactly 1/(n)_d for each compatible order. In mixed factorial moments all non-disjoint intersections have fewer free vertices than color-arc constraints, hence vanish at O(1/n); clean events yield moment one, proving independent Poi(1). With high probability endpoint and two-color edge defects are disjoint. Rank-one unary types are exactly realized pair masks, so rank-two sentences are Boolean combinations of their existence and depend only on signed overlap supports. All Boolean functions of these supports are explicitly rank-two definable. Bernoulli limit and transcendence of exp(-1) give the exact distinct-value count. Exact finite checker verified n=3..7 for two colors.

value.rationale: The exact full spectrum is a natural logical observable on the independently traversed relational systems studied in 2026. Distinguishing all rank-two asymptotic probabilities, not just a selected formula, reveals the exact expressivity boundary: rare signed pair-overlaps are the only stochastic two-round types. The number of possible values grows from 12 at r=2 to 1,053,696 at r=3; this is a full classification and explains probability behavior in a current finite model-theory setting.
